Name: EQUIPMENT_MENU_MANAGE_CATEGORY_PARAM_ST
Description: Categories of the equipment menu: the parameter layout, name, icon, sort order and help video of each category.

Fields.Name: Menu Layout
Fields.Description: MenuPropertyLayoutParam row that sets the list of parameters shown in the menu for this category.

Fields.Name: Category Name ID
Fields.Description: Menu text ID of the category name.

Fields.Name: Category Icon ID
Fields.Description: Icon of the category (EquipCategory icon ID).

Fields.Name: Sort ID
Fields.Description: Sort order of the category in the menu.

Fields.Name: Help ID
Fields.Description: ID of the help video for the category.
